item.title: Five men arrested in Tonga drug raids as police seize methamphetamine, cannabis and cash
item.description: Five men aged between 30 and 55 have been arrested following two police operations in Tonga that uncovered methamphetamine, cannabis, cash in three currencies and suspected drug-related equipment. Tonga Police confirmed on Friday, 20 November 2026, that the raids were conducted on 13 and 16 November in Puke, Haʻateiho, Mataika and Maʻufanga.
item.content:encoded:
Five men aged between 30 and 55 have been arrested following two police operations in Tonga that uncovered methamphetamine, cannabis, cash in three currencies and suspected drug-related equipment.

Tonga Police confirmed on Friday, 20 November 2026, that the raids were conducted on 13 and 16 November in Puke, Haʻateiho, Mataika and Maʻufanga.

Officers seized cash in Tongan paʻanga, New Zealand dollars and British pounds, along with drug-related utensils and electronic devices.

All five suspects have been charged with offences relating to the possession of illicit drugs and drug-related utensils.

Police did not disclose the suspects’ identities, the quantities of drugs confiscated or the total amount of money recovered.

The statement also provided no details about court appearances or when the cases would be heard.

Tonga Police reaffirmed its commitment to combating illegal drug possession and distribution, urging the public to report information that could help authorities protect communities.
